crossRefs.note: The grass withers, the flower fades, because Yahweh’s breath blows on it. Surely the people are like grass.

translations.web: The grass withers, the flower fades, because Yahweh’s breath blows on it. Surely the people are like grass.
translations.bsb: The grass withers and the flowers fall when the breath of the LORD blows on them; indeed, the people are grass.
translations.kjv: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the LORD bloweth upon it: surely the people is grass.
translations.asv: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth, because the breath of Jehovah bloweth upon it; surely the people is grass.
